blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The real-world usability of ASR models remains challenging, particularly for low-resource languages, where existing speech resources are often collected in clean studio environments. In this work, we introduce TeleASR-Amharic, a benchmark for evaluating Amharic ASR under various acoustic and telecommunication conditions. We analyze the major degradations observed in real telecommunications recordings and develop a benchmark that covers multiple channel conditions, environmental disturbances, and telecom-domain variations. Our results show that telecommunication degradation can substantially reduce recognition performance, making even high-performing ASR models impractical under severe conditions. For example, the WER of the best-performing model increases from 0.23 to 0.79 under severe telecommunication degradation, corresponding to a relative increase of 243% in recognition errors. We further investigate the effects of different noise and channel distortions and show that scaling training data and applying carefully designed telecommunication-aware augmentation substantially improve robustness. In particular, our best training configuration achieves a 23.6% relative WER reduction under extreme noise conditions. Together with the release of our telecommunications-domain data, these findings provide a reproducible benchmark for measuring progress in Amharic ASR while highlighting open challenges in developing robust speech technologies for real-world deployment.
blocks.zh: ASR模型的现实世界可用性仍然具有挑战性,特别是对资源匮乏的语言而言,在清洁的工作室环境中往往收集到现有的语音资源. 在这项工作中,我们介绍了TeleASR-Amharic,这是在各种声学和电信条件下评价Amharic ASR的基准. 我们分析在真实电信录音中观察到的主要退化情况,并制定一个涵盖多种信道条件、环境扰动和电信领域变化的基准。 我们的结果显示,电信的退化可大大地降低识别性能,使即使是高性能的ASR模型在严峻条件下也变得不切实际. 例如,在严重的电信退化下,表现最好的模型的WER从0.23增加到了0.79,相当于识别错误的相对增加243%. 我们进一步调查不同噪音和信道扭曲的影响,并表明,扩大培训数据的规模和运用精心设计的电信意识增强能大大地提高稳健性。 特别是,我们最好的训练配置在极端噪音条件下实现了相对WER减少23.6%. 这些结论与我们公布的电信领域数据一道,为衡量阿姆哈拉语ASR的进展提供了一个可复制的基准,同时突出了在为实际世界部署开发强有力的语音技术方面的公开挑战。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1: Examples of problematic ASR transcriptions in the telecommunications domain. The analysis shows that models frequently miss numeric information and that transcription performance varies substantially across different audio-quality conditions.
blocks.zh: 图 1:电信领域存在问题的ASR转录实例. 分析显示,模型经常漏掉数字信息,不同音频质量条件的抄录性能差异很大.

blocks.en: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) has advanced rapidly in recent years, driven by significant developments in supervised learning, self-supervised representation learning, and multilingual modeling Yadav and Sitaram (2022) ; Mohamed et al. (2022) ; Ahlawat et al. (2025) ; Lugo and Vielzeuf (2024) . These advances, together with the emergence of large-scale speech models, have substantially expanded the range of languages, speakers, and acoustic conditions that contemporary ASR systems can handle. However, strong performance under clean or controlled speech does not necessarily translate into reliable recognition in real-world communication environments Pranida et al. (2025a) .
blocks.zh: 近年来,在监督学习、自我监督的代表学习以及Yadav和Sitaram(2022年)、Mohamed等人(2022年)、Ahlawat等人(2025年)、Lugo和Vielzeuf(2024年)等多语种模式的重大发展推动下,自动语音识别(ASR)取得了迅速进展。 这些进步,加上大规模语音模型的出现,大大扩大了当代ASR系统所能处理的语言,扬声器,声学条件的范围. 然而,在清洁或受控制的语音下,强效表现不一定转化为在现实世界通信环境中的可靠识别Pranida等人(2025a).

blocks.en: Unlike conventional clean-speech benchmarks, telecommunication speech can exhibit combinations of bandwidth limitations, sampling-rate reductions, dynamic-range compressions, nonlinear distortions, electrical interferences, background noises, and temporary signal losses Paul and Fuji (2026) . Such distortions may occur at different stages of the communication process and can vary substantially in terms of severity. Consequently, evaluating ASR systems only on clean or naturally recorded speech provides limited information about their robustness to the conditions encountered in real-world communication channels Imai et al. (2025) ; Pranida et al. (2025b) . Therefore, a systematic evaluation framework that isolates and controls these factors is necessary to understand how ASR systems respond to progressively degraded speech.
blocks.zh: 与常规的清音基准不同,电信语音可以显示带宽限制,采样率降低,动态测距压缩,非线性扭曲,电干扰,背景噪声,以及临时信号损失等组合. Paul and Fuji (2026). 这种扭曲可能发生在通信过程的不同阶段,在严重程度上可能有很大差异。 因此,仅根据干净或自然录制的言论评价ASR系统,对Imai等人(2025年)和Pranida等人(2025年b年)在现实世界通信渠道中遇到的条件的强度提供的信息有限。 因此,为了了解ASR系统如何应对逐渐退化的言论,必须有一个系统化的评价框架,孤立和控制这些因素。

blocks.en: Publicly available Amharic speech and transcription resources are substantially smaller than those available for high-resource languages Nigatu and Aldarmaki (2025) ; CLEAR Global (2026) . Recent efforts have expanded Amharic speech resources and demonstrated the feasibility of constructing larger corpora Diack et al. (2026) ; Yeneneh et al. (2025) ; Radford and others (2026) . Self-supervised and multilingual models can further reduce the dependence on large amounts of transcribed data by transferring representations learned from multilingual speech Baevski et al. (2020) ; Pratap et al. (2023) . Nevertheless, increasing linguistic coverage does not necessarily resolve the acoustic domain mismatch. A model may adequately represent Amharic linguistic patterns while remaining sensitive to the signal degradation introduced by microphones, mobile devices, and communication networks.
blocks.zh: 公开使用的阿姆哈拉语语音和转写资源大大少于高资源语言Nigatu和Aldarmaki(2025年);CLEAR Global(2026年). 最近的努力扩大了阿姆哈拉语的语音资源,证明了建造更大的Corpora Diack等人(2026年);Yeneneh等人(2025年);Radford等人(2026年)的可行性。 自我监督和多语种模型可以进一步减少对大量转录数据的依赖,方法是转移从多语种语音Baevski et al.(2020年)学到的表示力; Pratap et al.(2023年). 尽管如此,增加语言覆盖范围并不一定解决音域不匹配问题. 一个模型可能充分代表阿姆哈拉语语言模式,同时对麦克风、移动装置和通信网络带来的信号退化保持敏感。

blocks.en: To investigate this problem, we analyze the acoustic characteristics of recordings of Ethio Telecom and identify signal degradations that distinguish telecommunication speech from clean speech. Based on these observations, we constructed TeleASR-Amharic , a benchmark to evaluate the robustness of ASR systems under controlled telecommunication-oriented acoustic conditions. Rather than representing degraded speech as a single evaluation category, the benchmark models a range of environmental, hardware, and communication-channel distortions at different severity levels. These include bandwidth limitation, sampling-rate reduction, dynamic-range compression, nonlinear distortion, background noise, power-line interference, and temporal signal dropouts. To deal with these problems, we ask RQ1: How robust are Amharic-specific, multilingual, and general-purpose ASR models to telecommunication-specific acoustic degradation? Next, we explore RQ2: how ASR performance changes as the severity and combination of telecommunication degradations increase? to deal with this problems of domain mismatch and noise robustness we RQ3: explore the effect of data scaling and targeted augmentation to improve the robustness of Amharic ASR models under telecommunication conditions?
blocks.zh: 为了调查这个问题,我们分析Ethio Telecom录音的声学特征,并找出区别电信语音和干净语音的信号退化. 基于这些观测结果,我们构建了TeleASR-Amharic,这是在受控制的电信导向声学条件下评价ASR系统的稳健性的基准. 基准不是将退化的言论作为单一的评价类别,而是在不同严重性层面模拟一系列环境、硬件和通信渠道的扭曲。 其中包括带宽限制,采样率降低,动态测距压缩,非线性扭曲,背景噪声,动力线干扰,以及时间信号中断. 为了处理这些问题,我们请问RQ1: 阿姆哈拉语专用、多语种和通用的ASR模型对电信专用声学退化的强度如何? 其次,我们探索RQ2:随着电信退化的严重性和结合程度的提高,ASR性能是如何变化的? 我们RQ3:探索数据缩放和定向增强的效果,以提高Amharic ASR模型在电信条件下的稳健性?

blocks.en: To answer these questions, we made the following contributions:
blocks.zh: 为了回答这些问题,我们作了以下贡献:

blocks.en: • We introduce TeleASR-Amharic , a benchmark for evaluating the robustness of Amharic ASR systems under controlled, telecommunication oriented acoustic conditions. Data relesed under a CC BY 4.0 license with free access 1 1 1 GSMA/TeleASR-Amharic . • We provide a comprehensive evaluation of Amharic-specific, multilingual, and general-purpose ASR models across clean and progressively degraded conditions, enabling direct comparison of their robustness to telecommunication effects. • We investigate the contribution of data scaling and targeted augmentation to robust Amharic ASR and analyze the behavior of the model.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Amharic is one of Ethiopia’s major languages and is widely used across public services, education, media, and digital applications. However, it remains under-resourced, with limited transcribed speech and substantial variation across speakers, dialects, devices, acoustic environments, and speaking styles Nigatu and Aldarmaki (2025) ; Imam et al. (2025) ; Bandarupalli et al. (2025) ; Bartelds et al. (2023) ; Liu et al. (2024) ; Dhasmana et al. (2026) . This creates both linguistic and acoustic coverage gaps, as existing corpora often lack the variability encountered in real-world deployment. Therefore, we evaluate Amharic ASR beyond clean speech, focusing on robustness to realistic telecommunication conditions and domain-specific content, including numbers, terminology, and expressions used in customer-support interactions.
blocks.zh: 阿姆哈拉语是埃塞俄比亚的主要语言之一,广泛用于公共服务、教育、媒体和数字应用。 然而,它仍然资源不足,转录的语音有限,各语种,方言,装置,声学环境,和说话风格差异很大,分别是尼加图语和阿尔达马基语(2025年);伊玛目等人语(2025年);班达鲁帕利等人语(2025年);巴尔特尔兹等人语(2023年);刘等人语(2024年);达斯马纳等人语(2026年). 这就造成了语言和声学的覆盖范围差距,因为现有的公司往往缺乏现实世界部署中遇到的变异性。 因此,我们评价Amharic ASR超越了干净的言语,侧重于对现实电信条件的稳健性和特定领域的内容,包括数字、术语和客户支持互动中使用的表达方式。

blocks.en: Telecommunication speech represents a distinct ASR domain because transmission channels introduce systematic acoustic transformations beyond additive noise. Narrow-band telephony typically operates at 300–3400 Hz, limiting phonetic information and creating a domain shift that can degrade recognition performance International Telecommunication Union (2009) ; International Telecommunication Union (2011) ; International Telecommunication Union (1988a) . Sampling rates impose further spectral constraints, with 8 kHz sampling limiting the representable spectrum to 4 kHz International Telecommunication Union (1988b) ; International Telecommunication Union (2012) . Studies show that bandwidth mismatch between training and evaluation speech can substantially reduce ASR performance Ẇe therefore explicitly evaluate Amharic ASR robustness under realistic telecommunication channel conditions and transmission-induced degradation Malik et al. (2021) .
blocks.zh: 电信语音代表着一个独特的ASR域,因为传输通道引入了超越添加噪音的系统声学变换. 窄带电话一般在300-3400时运行 Hz, 限制语音信息并创建可以降低识别性能的域位转移 国际电信联盟 (2009); 国际电信联盟 (2011); 国际电信联盟 (1988a). 采样率进一步限制了光谱,8千赫采样将可代表光谱限制在4千赫;国际电信联盟(2012年)。 研究表明,培训与评价演讲之间的带宽不匹配可大幅降低ASR的性能. 因此,e明确评价Amharic ASR在现实电信通道条件下的稳健性以及传输引起的退化Malik等人(2021年)。

blocks.en: Robust ASR has traditionally addressed acoustic mismatch through normalization, noise compensation, adaptation, enhancement, and multi-condition training Shah and Raj (2025) ; Wang and Wang (2026) . Data augmentation provides a complementary approach by exposing models to diverse acoustic conditions and reducing sensitivity to nuisance variability Mengke and Mihajlik (2026) ; Kermanshahi et al. (2026) ; Venkateswaran and Liu (2024) . Established methods such as SpecAugment and waveform-level perturbation improve robustness, whereas recent work emphasizes acoustic-aware and deployment-specific augmentation Park et al. (2019) ; Ko et al. (2015) ; Liu et al. (2025) ; Zhang et al. (2021) ; Hao et al. (2026) . For telecommunications, augmentation should capture interacting effects such as bandwidth limitations, resampling, compression, nonlinear distortion, noise, and temporal signal loss Wang et al. (2026) . Randomized channel augmentation can further capture variability by sampling distortion types and severities rather than relying on a fixed channel profile Lin et al. (2025) ; Bartelds et al. (2023) . We apply this principle to Amharic through telecommunication-aware augmentation based on observed channel degradation and evaluate robustness under both controlled and randomized conditions.
blocks.zh: 强力ASR传统上通过正常化,噪声补偿,适应,增强,以及多条件训练等方法解决声学不匹配问题. Shah and Raj (2025); Wang and Wang (2026). 数据增强提供了一种补充性方法,通过将模型暴露于不同的声学条件,并降低对扰动变异Mengke和Mihajlik的敏感性(2026年);Kermanshahi等人(2026年);Venkateswaran和Liu(2024年)。 诸如SpecAgment和波形水平扰动等既定方法提高了稳健性,而最近的工作强调声学意识和部署特定的增强公园等(2019年);Ko等人(2015年);Liu等人(2025年); 张等 (2021年); 郝等 (2026年). 对于电信,增强应捕捉带宽限制,重塑,压缩,非线性扭曲,噪声,以及时间信号损失等相互作用效应 Wang et al. (2026). 随机的通道增强可以通过取样扭曲类型和断裂来进一步捕捉变异性,而不是依靠固定的通道剖面Lin等人(2025年);Bartelds等人(2023年). 我们根据观测到的通道退化情况,通过电信意识增强,对阿姆哈拉语适用这一原则,并在受控和随机条件下评价稳健性。

blocks.en:
Collecting and manually transcribing speech across diverse deployment conditions is costly, making synthetic audio generation a practical way to expand acoustic coverage without new linguistic annotations Casanova and others (2023) ; Radford et al. (2023) ; Bartelds et al. (2023) ; Hao et al. (2026) .
This is particularly useful for low-resource ASR, where synthetic augmentation can increase training data and acoustic diversity through realistic channel, noise, and codec variations DeRenzi et al. (2025) ; Moslem (2024) ; Li et al. (2025) ; Joshi and Singh (2022) ; Casanova and others (2023) ; Radford et al. (2023) . In this work, we generate telecommunication-degraded Amharic speech from existing transcribed utterances using controlled channel transformations designed to reflect realistic Ethiopian telecommunication conditions.
blocks.zh:
在不同的部署条件下收集和手动转录语音,费用高昂,使合成音频生成成为在没有新的语言说明卡萨诺瓦等人(2023年)的情况下扩大声学覆盖范围的实用方法;拉德福德等人(2023年);巴尔特尔兹等人(2023年);郝等人(2026年).
这对低资源ASR特别有用,在ASR中,合成增强可以通过现实的通道,噪声,和编码变异Derenzi等人(2025年);Moslem等人(2024年);Li等人(2025年);Joshi和Singh等人(2022年);Casanova等人(2023年);Radford等人(2023年)增加培训数据和声学多样性. 在这项工作中,我们利用旨在反映现实的埃塞俄比亚电信条件的可控信道转换,从现有的转录语音中生成电信降级的阿姆哈拉语。

blocks.en: 3 TeleASR-Amharic Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 TeleASR-阿姆哈拉数据集

blocks.en: Below, we describe each step involved in creating our telecom robustness benchmark, as illustrated in Figure 2 . Although synthetic augmentation may not fully capture real-world scenarios, it provides a controlled setting for studying model robustness. By introducing specific types of noise while keeping the domain and speaker identity constant, we can isolate the effects of individual perturbations and investigate whether observed performance degradation is attributable to the introduced noise rather than changes in domain or speaker characteristics.
blocks.zh: 下面,我们描述我们建立电信稳健性基准的每个步骤,如图2所示。 虽然合成增强可能不能完全捕捉现实世界的情景,但它为研究模型稳健性提供了一个可控的设置. 通过引入特定类型的噪声,同时保持域和扬声器特性不变,我们可以隔离个别扰动的影响,并调查观察到的性能退化是否可归因于引入的噪声而不是域或扬声器特性的变化.

blocks.en: 3.1 EthioTelecom Conversation & Failures Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.1 EthioTelecom 对话与失败分析

blocks.en: TeleASR-Amharic was motivated by the lack of robust ASR evaluation benchmarks that reflect real-world telecommunications customer-support scenarios. We first evaluated several ASR models on internal Ethio Telecom recordings and observed substantial recognition errors, particularly under conditions representative of real-world deployments. Our analysis identified two key challenges.
blocks.zh: TeleASR-Amharic的动机是缺乏反映真实世界电信客户支助情景的强有力的ASR评价基准。 我们首先评价了Ethio Telecom内部录音的几个ASR模型,并观察到大量识别错误,特别是在代表现实世界部署的条件下。 我们的分析确定了两个主要挑战。

blocks.en: First, acoustic and channel degradation: Ethio Telecom recordings exhibit the characteristics of narrowband telephony, low-bitrate speech codecs, and heterogeneous mobile network conditions. These artifacts alter the spectral and temporal characteristics of speech, thereby creating additional challenges for automatic speech recognition.
blocks.zh: 第一,声学和信道退化: Ethio Telecom录音显示了窄带电话、低比特语音编码器和多样移动网络条件的特点。 这些文物改变了语音的光谱和时间特征,从而对自动语音识别造成了更多的挑战.

blocks.en: Second, numerical information: Telecommunications customer support interactions frequently involve numbers, including phone numbers, account identifiers, balances, dates, and transaction amounts. We observed that ASR models struggled to represent such information consistently, often mixing written number words with numerical digits. This inconsistency is particularly problematic for downstream telecommunications applications, in which the accurate transcription of numerical information is essential.
blocks.zh: 第二,数字信息: 电信客户支持互动经常涉及数字,包括电话号码、账户识别符、余额、日期和交易金额。 我们注意到,ASR模型一直努力代表这种信息,常常将书面数字词与数字词混为一谈。 这种不一致对于下游电信应用来说尤其成问题,在这些应用中,准确记录数字信息至关重要。

blocks.en: Although these observations were derived from real Ethio Telecom recordings, the recordings cannot be used or released as a benchmark because they contain sensitive information, including names, phone numbers, account details, and payment-related discussions. Therefore, we developed TeleASR-Amharic using synthetic speech that preserves the relevant linguistic and acoustic characteristics of telecommunications interactions without exposing real individuals or their sensitive information.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些观察来自真正的Ethio Telecom录音,但是这些录音不能作为基准使用或发布,因为它们包含敏感的信息,包括姓名,电话号码,账户细节,以及与支付有关的讨论. 因此,我们开发了TeleASR-Amharic,使用合成语音,保留了电信相互作用的相关语言和声学特征,而不暴露真实的个体或其敏感信息.

blocks.en: 3.2 Source Material Collection
blocks.zh: 3.2 来源材料收集

blocks.en: Table 1: Speech duration statistics by gender for the TeleASR-Amharic dataset.

blocks.en: We collected real-life transcribed conversations, SMS support use cases, customer support FAQs, and agent training materials to capture realistic domain vocabulary and typical customer scenarios.
blocks.zh: 我们收集了真实生活中的转录对话,短信支持使用案例,客户支持FAQ,以及代理培训材料,以获取现实域词汇和典型的客户情景.

blocks.en: 3.3 Multiturn Conversation Generation
blocks.zh: 3.3 多回合对话生成

blocks.en: Using the collected source materials as grounding documents, we generated 10-turn user–assistant conversations covering numbers, culturally specific names, and common telecommunications problems. The generated conversations were reviewed by Ethio Telecom experts and regenerated to address the identified issues, including inconsistencies in greetings and required closing statements specified by Ethio Telecom protocols.
blocks.zh: 使用收集的原始资料作为基础文件,我们产生了10个用户辅助对话,涉及数字、文化上的具体名称和常见的电信问题。 Ethio Telecom专家审查了所产生的对话,并重新生成这些对话,以解决已查明的问题,包括问候中的不一致之处,以及Ethio Telecom协议规定的结束语。

blocks.en: 3.4 Audio Recording
blocks.zh: 3.4 录音

blocks.en: Eight paid contributors were selected from an existing contributor pool based on their record of approved speech-data submissions. Their speech varieties were identified through a dialect-identification task and verified by human reviewers. The selected speakers represented the Addis Ababa and Shewa varieties of Amharic. For each scripted dialogue, contributors were paired, with one acting as a telecom customer and the other as a customer-service agent. Recording tasks were distributed through the gheero crowd-sourcing platform 2 2 2 https://gheero.et/ . Each contributor used a smartphone to record the assigned utterances in the same studio, with customer and agent turns stored as separate audio files. Before recording, all contributors provided informed consent, and direct identifiers were removed from the associated metadata. The detailed dataset statistics of the final data are shown in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 根据已核准的语音数据提交记录,从现有缴款人库中挑选了8名付费缴款人。 他们的语音品种通过方言识别任务被识别出来,并经过人类审查人员核实. 选定的发言者代表亚的斯亚贝巴和谢瓦的阿姆哈拉品种。 对于每个脚本对话,都对撰稿人进行配对,其中一人担任电信客户,另一人担任客户服务代理。 录音任务通过gheero众包平台2 2 2 https://gheero.et/分配. 每个贡献者都使用智能手机在同一工作室记录分配的语句,客户和代理人转身作为单独的音频文件存储. 在录制之前,所有贡献者都提供了知情同意,直接识别信息从相关的元数据中删除。 最后数据的详细数据集统计数据见表1。

blocks.en: A human reviewer listened to every submitted recording and compared it with the corresponding script. Each recording was assessed for audibility, completeness, adherence to the reference text, and correct assignment of the customer or agent role. Submissions containing excessive background noise, missing audio, incorrect content, or mismatches between the audio and reference transcription were rejected. Following quality control, the final dataset comprised 15,965 utterances totaling 30.63 hours of recorded speech.
blocks.zh: 一位人文评论员聆听了所有提交的录音,并将其与相应的剧本进行比较. 每项记录都经过评估,以明晰性、完整性、遵守参考文本以及正确分配客户或代理人的作用。 载有过多背景噪音、缺少音频、内容不正确或音频与参考记录不符的材料被拒绝。 在质量控制之后,最后数据集包括15 965个语句,共计30.63小时。

(2025) and created configuration files for each dataset. All evaluations and model training were conducted using a single NVIDIA A100 GPU with 80 GB of memory.
blocks.zh: 为了确保对ASR模型进行可复制的评价,我们遵循了开放ASR Leaderboard Srivastav et al. (2025)所采用的方法,并为每个数据集创建了配置文件. 所有评价和示范培训都使用一个具有80GB内存的单一NVIDIA A100GPU进行.

blocks.en: 5 Result and Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 结果和分析

blocks.en: For model training, we adopted the training framework provided by EthioASR Abdullah et al. (2026) . We selected the best-performing model based on WER in our initial evaluation and continued fine-tuning from its pretrained checkpoint using our collected Amharic datasets. We extended the text-processing pipeline with number-to-text normalization by converting numerical digits into their corresponding Amharic word forms. During fine-tuning, audio augmentation was applied stochastically using Gaussian noise, random gain adjustments, and simulated environmental and telecommunication distortions, including amplitude modulation, band-pass filtering, codec resampling, dynamic-range compression, nonlinear distortion, power-line hum, and packet-loss dropouts. Following augmentation, the waveforms were peak-normalized when necessary to prevent clipping.
blocks.zh: 作为示范培训,我们采用了EthioASR Abdullah等人(2026年)提供的培训框架。 我们在初步评估中选择了基于WER的最好运作模式,并使用我们收集的阿姆哈拉数据集,继续从其经过预先训练的检查站进行微调。 我们通过将数字数字转换成对应的阿姆哈拉语单词形式,扩大了文本处理管道,实现了数字到文本的正常化。 在微调期间,音频增强被应用成条形,使用高斯噪声,随机增益调整,模拟环境和电信扭曲,包括振幅调制,波段-通过过滤,编码重印,动态测距压缩,非线性扭曲,动力线hum,以及包丢失的退出. 增强后,必要时将波形进行峰值正常化,以防止剪切.

blocks.en: We evaluate a diverse set of ASR systems spanning Amharic-specific, multilingual, and general-purpose models. The evaluated systems include Ethio-ASR-Amharic and Ethio-ASR-multilingual models Abdullah et al. (2026) with 94M, 300M, and 600M parameters; OmniASR CTC models Omnilingual ASR Team et al. (2025) with 300M, 1B, 3B, and 7B parameters; and OmniASR LLM models with 300M, 1B, 3B, and 7B parameters. We also evaluate the OmniASR-v2 300M and 1B CTC models, MMS-1B Pratap et al. (2023) , Distil-Whisper Gandhi et al. (2023) , and the Whisper family Radford et al. (2023) , including small, large-v3, and large-v3-turbo. Together, these models cover language-specific, multilingual, and general-purpose ASR approaches with substantially different model sizes and training paradigms.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了一套涵盖阿姆哈拉语特定、多语种和通用模式的各种ASR系统。 评估的系统包括Ethio-ASR-Amharic和Ethio-ASR-多种语言模型Abdullah等人(2026年),有94M、300M和600M参数;OmniASR CTC模型Omnilangular ASR Team等人(2025年),有300M、1B、3B和7B参数;OmniASR LLM模型,有300M、1B、3B和7B参数。 我们还评价OmniASR-v2 300M和1B CTC模型、MMS-1B Pratap等人(2023年)、Distil-Whisper Gandhi等人(2023年)和Whisper家族Radford等人(2023年),包括小型、大型v3和大型v3涡轮。 这些模式加在一起,涵盖语言专用、多语种和通用的ASR方法,其模型大小和培训范式大不相同。

blocks.en: Before computing WER and CER, we normalized both reference transcripts and model predictions using the same text-processing procedure. Numerical digits were converted to their corresponding Amharic word forms, punctuation was removed, and Amharic character variants were normalized. This ensures that the evaluation differences primarily reflect recognition errors rather than differences in formatting or character representation.
blocks.zh: 在计算WER和CER之前,我们使用相同的文本处理程序,使参考记录和模型预测正常化. 数字化数字被转换成相应的阿姆哈拉语单词形式,去掉标点符号,阿姆哈拉语字符变体被正常化. 这确保了评价差异主要反映识别错误,而不是格式或性格表现的差异。

blocks.en: RQ1:How robust are Amharic-specific, multilingual, and general-purpose ASR models to telecommunication-specific acoustic degradation?
blocks.zh: RQ1: 阿姆哈拉语特异性、多语种和通用ASR模型对电信特异性声学退化的强度如何?

blocks.en: We evaluated the robustness of the ASR systems across a range of acoustic and telecommunication conditions, including clean studio speech, environmental noise, low-energy speech, harsh acoustic environments, narrowband communication with packet loss, randomized telephone channels, and a wideband VoLTE-like channel. We report the word error rate (WER), where lower values indicate better recognition performance. The overall score reported in the average column is the arithmetic mean across the eight evaluation conditions. This provides a single measure of overall robustness while preserving the condition-specific results needed to identify sources of recognition degradation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了ASR系统在一系列声学和电信条件下的稳健性,包括清洁录音室演讲,环境噪音,低能演讲,恶劣的声学环境,带包丢失的窄带通信,随机化的电话频道,以及类似VOLTE的宽带频道. 我们报告单词错误率(WER),其中较低的值表示更好的识别性能. 平均栏中报告的总得分是8个评价条件的算术平均值。 这为总体稳健性提供了单一的衡量标准,同时保留了识别识别退化源所需的特定条件结果。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 3 , substantial differences in robustness can be observed across the evaluated model families. The Amharic-specific Ethio-ASR-Amharic model achieves the lowest overall WER of 46.57%, making it the strongest-performing model across the complete evaluation suite. It is followed by the multilingual Ethio-ASR-Multilingual-600M model, with an average WER of 53.98%. The best-performing general-purpose models are considerably less consistent across the different acoustic conditions.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,在被评价的模范家庭中,体力差异很大。 阿姆哈拉语特有Ethio-ASR-Amharic模型实现46.57%的最低整体WER,使其成为整个评价套件中表现最强的模型. 随后是多语种Ethio-ASR-多语种-600M模式,平均WER为53.98%. 在不同的声学条件下,性能最好的通用模型相差甚远。

blocks.en: The performance gap between the two largest Amharic-oriented models is particularly informative. Ethio-ASR-Amharic improves over Ethio-ASR-Multilingual-600M, reducing the average WER from 53.98% to 46.57%, corresponding to a relative reduction of approximately 13.7%. This result suggests that increasing multilingual coverage alone does not necessarily provide the same benefit as adapting acoustic and linguistic representations to the target language and deployment domain. This finding is especially relevant for low-resource ASR, where a model can benefit substantially from specialization, even when its parameter count is comparable to that of a multilingual alternative.
blocks.zh: 两个最大的阿姆哈拉语模式之间的性能差距特别大。 Ethio-ASR-Amharic比Ethio-ASR-多语言-600M改进,平均WERR从53.98%降至46.57%,相对减少约13.7%。 这一结果表明,仅仅增加多语种的覆盖面不一定能提供与使声学和语言表述适应目标语言和部署领域相同的惠益。 这一结论对资源低的ASR特别相关,因为即使其参数数与多语种替代品的参数数相当,该模型也能从专业化中大大受益。

blocks.en: The results also demonstrate that model size is not a sufficient predictor of robustness. Within the OmniASR family, increasing the parameter count does not consistently lead to lower WER. For example, OmniASR-CTC-7B obtains an average WER of 58.32%, whereas the smaller OmniASR-CTC-1B and OmniASR-CTC-300M models obtain 61.07% and 67.94%, respectively. Although the larger model performs better than these smaller variants overall, the relationship is not monotonic across all model families and conditions, despite their relatively large parameter counts. These observations indicate that robustness to telecommunication distortion depends not only on model capacity but also on language specialization, training distribution, architecture, and exposure to channel variability.
blocks.zh: 结果还表明,模型的大小不足以预测稳健性。 在OmniASR家族内部,增加参数计数并不能始终导致WER更低. 例如,OmniASR-CTC-7B的平均WER率为58.32%,而较小的OmniASR-CTC-1B和OmniASR-CTC-300M型分别获得61.07%和67.94%. 虽然较大的模型总体表现优于这些较小的变体,但这种关系并非在所有模型家庭和条件上都是单一的,尽管它们的参数数相对较大。 这些意见表明,电信扭曲的稳健性不仅取决于模型能力,而且还取决于语言专业化、培训分布、架构和接触频道变异性。

blocks.en: Under relatively clean conditions, Ethio-ASR-Amharic achieved the best WAXAL WER (23.25%), closely followed by Ethio-ASR-Multilingual-600M (23.82%). However, OmniASR-LLM-7B performed best on clean studio speech (31.59%), while Ethio-ASR-Amharic achieved 40.5%, showing that the Amharic-specific model is not uniformly superior under clean conditions.
blocks.zh: 在相对清洁的条件下,Ethio-ASR-Amharic取得了最好的WAXAL WER(23.25%),紧随其后的是Ethio-ASR-多语言-600M(23.82%). 然而,OmniASR-LLM-7B在清洁演播室演讲(31.59%)上表现最好,而Ethio-ASR-Amharic则取得了40.5%的成绩,这表明在清洁条件下阿姆哈拉特异性模型并不统一优越.

blocks.en: Under ambient room noise, Ethio-ASR-Amharic achieved 42.74%, substantially outperforming the OmniASR models (64.18–89.70%), indicating stronger resilience to environmental noise. However, for distant/low-volume speech, OmniASR-LLM-7B achieved the lowest WER (31.81%), compared with 40.59% for Ethio-ASR-Amharic. Overall, these results show that model strengths vary by acoustic condition, while the Amharic-specific model provides greater consistency across conditions.
blocks.zh: 在环境室噪声下,Ethio-ASR-Amharic取得了42.74%的成绩,大大超过OmniASR模型(64.18-89.70%),表明对环境噪声的抗御力更强. 然而,对于远程/低容量的语音,OmniASR-LLM-7B达到了最低的WER(31.81%),而Ethio-ASR-Amharic则达到了40.59%. 总体而言,这些结果显示模型的优点因声学条件而异,而阿姆哈拉语特异性模型则提供了不同条件的更大一致性.

blocks.en: RQ2: How does ASR performance change as the severity and combination of telecommunication degradations increase?
blocks.zh: RQ2:随着电信退化的严重程度和组合增加,ASR的性能如何变化?

blocks.en:

(Ethio-ASR-amharic) across eight evaluation conditions, ordered from least to

blocks.en: The largest performance degradation occurs under telecommunication conditions, particularly when narrowband communication is combined with packet loss. For Ethio-ASR-Amharic, WER increases from 40.57% under clean studio conditions to 79.36% under narrowband 2G with packet loss. This corresponds to an absolute increase of 38.79 percentage points and a relative increase of 95.6%. This substantial degradation demonstrates that the recognition performance under clean speech is not a reliable indicator of performance under realistic telecommunication conditions.
blocks.zh: 最大的性能退化发生在电信条件下,特别是在窄带通信与包件损失相结合的情况下。 对Ethio-ASR-Amharic来说,WER从清洁工作室条件下的40.57%增加到了窄带2G条件下的79.36%,包丢失. 这相当于绝对增长38.79%,相对增长95.6%。 这种严重的退化表明,在现实电信条件下,干净的言语下的识别性能不是可靠的性能指标。

blocks.en: The narrowband 2G condition is the most challenging condition for most evaluated models. Ethio-ASR-Multilingual-600M reaches a WER of 92.13%, while Ethio-ASR-Multilingual-94M and Ethio-ASR-Multilingual-300M reach 99.39% and 132.75%, respectively. The deterioration is therefore particularly pronounced for the multilingual Ethio-ASR variants. In contrast, OmniASR-CTC-7B achieves a WER of 68.03%, the best result under this condition, closely followed by OmniASR-CTC-3B at 68.52%.
blocks.zh: 窄带2G条件对于大多数被评价的模型来说是最具有挑战性的条件. Ethio-ASR-多种语言-600 M达到92.13%的WER,而Ethio-ASR-多语言-94M和Ethio-ASR-多语言-300M分别达到99.39%和132.75%. 因此,多语种的Ethio-ASR变体的恶化尤为明显。 相比之下,OmniASR-CTC-7B的WER为68.03%,是这种情况下的最佳结果,紧随其后的OmniASR-CTC-3B为68.52%.

blocks.en: The randomized phone-channel condition is particularly informative because it evaluates robustness to a distribution of channel characteristics rather than a single fixed degradation profile. Ethio-ASR-Amharic achieves the lowest WER at 50.67%, followed by Ethio-ASR-Multilingual-600M at 60.78%. This result supports the use of randomized channel conditions for robustness evaluation, as performance on a fixed channel does not necessarily predict robustness to broader channel variability.
blocks.zh: 随机化的电话通道状况尤其具有信息性,因为它对频道特征分布的稳健性进行评估,而不是单一的固定降解剖面. Ethio-ASR-阿姆哈拉语以50.67%达到最低的WER,其次是Ethio-ASR-多语言-600M,为60.78%. 这一结果支持使用随机化的信道条件进行强性评价,因为固定信道的性能不一定预测强性到更广泛的信道可变性.

blocks.en: A similar trend is observed for the wideband phone (VoLTE) condition. Ethio-ASR-Amharic achieves a WER of 49.29%, compared with 59.35% for Ethio-ASR-Multilingual-600M, giving the Amharic-specific model an advantage of approximately 10.06 percentage points. The consistent advantage across randomized and standardized telephone conditions further highlights the robustness of the Amharic-specific model.
blocks.zh: 宽带电话(VoLTE)状况也有类似趋势。 Ethio-ASR-阿姆哈拉语实现49.29%的WER,而Ethio-ASR-多语言600M的WER为59.35%,使得阿姆哈拉语特有模式的优势约为10.06个百分点. 随机化和标准化电话条件的一贯优势进一步突出了阿姆哈拉语特有模式的稳健性.

blocks.en: Interestingly, the performance gap between clean and telephone conditions varies substantially across model families. For Ethio-ASR-Amharic, WER increases from 40.57% under clean studio speech to 49.29% under wideband telephone conditions. In contrast, OmniASR-LLM-7B increases from 31.59% to 84.33%, representing a much larger degradation despite its stronger clean-speech performance. These results highlight the limitations of evaluating ASR systems exclusively on clean benchmarks: strong clean-speech accuracy does not necessarily translate into robustness under realistic channel transformations.
blocks.zh: 有趣的是,各模范家庭的清洁条件和电话条件之间的性能差距差别很大。 对于Ethio-ASR-Amharic,WER从清洁工作室语音的40.57%增加到宽带电话条件下的49.29%. 与此相反,OmniASR-LLM-7B从31.59%上升到84.33%,表明尽管清洁话音性能较强,但降解程度要大得多。 这些结果突出表明了完全根据清洁基准评估ASR系统的局限性:在现实的通道转换下,强烈的清洁话语精度并不一定转化为稳健性.

blocks.en: RQ3: Can data scaling and targeted augmentation improve the robustness of Amharic ASR models under telecommunication conditions?
blocks.zh: RQ3:在电信条件下,数据规模化和定向增强能否提高Amharic ASR模型的稳健性?

blocks.en: Figure 4 compares fine-tuning variants across WAXAL read speech, clean studio speech, ambient room noise, distant/low-volume microphone recordings, harsh environments, wideband telephone (VoLTE), randomized telephone channels, and narrowband 2G with packet loss. We ablate two training factors: data scaling, using the full training corpus, and simulated telecommunication-channel augmentation applied to either 10% or 40% of the training utterances.
blocks.zh: 图4比较了WAXAL阅读语音、清洁录音室语音、环境室噪音、远程/低音量麦克风录音、恶劣环境、宽频电话(VoLTE)、随机电话频道和窄带2G的微调变体以及包丢失。 我们放弃了两个培训因素:利用完整的培训大纲进行数据缩放,以及模拟电信通道扩增,10%或40%的培训言论都适用。

blocks.en: The combination of data scaling and 10% augmentation achieves the lowest WER across the degraded evaluation conditions. For example, under narrowband 2G with packet loss, for example, it reduces the WER from 0.794 for the baseline to 0.607, corresponding to a 23.6% relative WER reduction. Data scaling alone consistently outperforms augmentation alone, suggesting that increased training data coverage provides the largest contribution to robustness, while targeted augmentation provides complementary gains, particularly under more severe channel conditions.
blocks.zh: 数据缩放和10%的扩增相结合,在退化的评价条件下实现了最低的WER. 例如,在带包丢失的窄带2G下,它将WER从基线的0.794减少到0.607,相对WER减少23.6%. 仅靠数据扩展本身就始终超过业绩扩大,这表明增加培训数据覆盖面对稳健性的贡献最大,而目标扩大则带来补充性收益,特别是在更严峻的信道条件下。

blocks.en: Interestingly, the baseline performs best only on the in-domain WAXAL read-speech condition, achieving a WER of 0.232 compared with 0.258 for the best fine-tuned variant. This trade-off suggests that fine-tuning with larger and more diverse data can improve robustness to deployment conditions while causing a small reduction in performance on the original in-domain distribution.
blocks.zh: 有趣的是,基准只在域内WAXAL读音条件上表现最好,与最佳微调变体0.258相比,WER为0.232。 这种权衡表明,用更大和更多样化的数据进行微调,可以提高部署条件的稳健性,同时导致原域内分布的性能小幅下降.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: In this work, we investigated the applicability and robustness of ASR models for low-resource languages, focusing on Amharic in the context of telecommunications. Existing Amharic ASR datasets provide limited coverage of domain-specific and noisy acoustic conditions, making it difficult to assess model robustness in real-world telecom scenarios. To address this gap, we introduced TeleASR-Amharic, a 30-hour benchmark covering seven diverse audio conditions designed to reflect realistic telecommunication environments. Our evaluation highlights the key challenges in deploying ASR models under acoustic and channel degradation and demonstrates that both data scaling and domain-specific augmentation can substantially improve ASR robustness.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们调查了低资源语言的ASR模型的适用性和稳健性,重点是电信背景下的阿姆哈拉语. 现有的阿姆哈拉语ASR数据集对特定领域和吵闹的声学条件的覆盖范围有限,因此难以评估现实世界电信情景中的模型稳健性. 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了TeleASR-Amharic,这是一个30小时的基准,涵盖七个不同的音频条件,旨在反映现实的电信环境。 我们的评价突出强调了在声学和信道退化下部署ASR模型的主要挑战,并表明数据规模化和特定域的增强都能够大大提高ASR的稳健性。

blocks.en: As a next step, we plan to extend this conversational ASR resource to the evaluation of speech-to-speech systems. In particular, the dataset can provide a foundation for studying whether improvements in speech recognition under realistic conversational and telecommunication conditions translate into more reliable end-to-end spoken language systems.
blocks.zh: 作为下一步,我们计划将这种对话性ASR资源扩展到语音对语音系统的评价. 特别是,数据集可以为研究在现实的对话和电信条件下改善语音识别是否转化为更可靠的端对端口语系统提供一个基础.

blocks.en: 7 Ethical Consideration
blocks.zh: 7. 道德考虑

blocks.en: This study addresses privacy , fairness, and responsible use in developing robust Amharic ASR for telecommunication speech.
blocks.zh: 这项研究涉及隐私、公平以及负责任的使用,

blocks.en: Speech data are handled according to applicable data-use agreements, institutional requirements, and privacy regulations. Identifying metadata are protected where applicable, access to non-public recordings is restricted, and raw recordings are not publicly released.
blocks.zh: 语音数据按照适用的数据使用协议、机构要求和隐私条例处理。 酌情保护识别元数据,限制获取非公开录音,不公开发布原始录音。

blocks.en: Synthetic augmentation diversifies acoustic realizations but does not remove source-data biases in speaker, language variety, or recording-condition representation.
blocks.zh: 合成增强拓扑拓扑实现声学,但不会消除语音,语言多样性或录音条件表达方面的源数据偏差.

blocks.en: Recognition performance is compared across the available male and female speaker groups. The differences are interpreted as model performance variations and not inherent speaker differences. The findings are limited by the demographic coverage of the dataset and cannot be generalized beyond the evaluated population.
blocks.zh: 现有男女演讲者群体对表彰表现进行比较。 这些差异被解释为模型性能差异,而不是固有的演讲者差异. 调查结果受数据集的人口覆盖范围的限制,不能超越评估的人口范围。

blocks.en: ASR systems may be used in sensitive or high-stakes settings; therefore, the results do not establish suitability for unrestricted legal, medical, law enforcement, or surveillance applications. Performance degradation under certain telecommunications conditions highlights the need for deployment-specific validation.
blocks.zh: ASR系统可用于敏感或高吸附环境;因此,结果不能确定是否适合不受限制的法律、医疗、执法或监视应用。 某些电信条件下的性能下降突出表明需要具体部署的验证。

blocks.en: Reproducibility is supported through benchmark descriptions, preprocessing procedures, augmentation configurations, evaluation scripts, and other non-sensitive resources when raw recordings cannot be shared. Synthetic degradations are distinguished from observed telecommunications artifacts to avoid overstating their real-world correspondence.
blocks.zh: 在无法共享原始录音时,通过基准描述,预处理程序,增强配置,评价脚本等非敏感资源支持可复制性. 合成降解与被观测到的电信文物有区别,以避免其真实世界的通信被过度统计.

blocks.en: Overall, this study promotes robust Amharic ASR through privacy, fairness, reproducibility, and responsible deployment within the study’s data and acoustic conditions.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这项研究通过隐私、公平、可复制性,以及负责任地在研究的数据和声学条件下进行部署,促进了阿姆哈拉语ASR。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
TeleASR-Amharic is currently limited to evaluating the robustness of ASR under
telecommunication conditions. However, the small pool of speakers may not fully represent the variations in the different dialects of Amharic. The lack of publicly available real-call audio also limits validation under real-world conditions, including authentic mobile codec artifacts and other channel effects. Privacy and consent requirements may further restrict access to real-call recordings. In addition, data augmentation may not capture all real-world variations, potentially limiting generalization to unseen conditions. Future work can address these limitations by including more diverse speakers, validating simulated conditions against real-call data where feasible, and extending the benchmark to evaluate end-to-end speech systems and other components of spoken telecommunications.
blocks.zh:
TeleASR-Amharic目前仅限于评估ASR是否可靠。
电信条件. 然而,人数不多的讲者可能不能充分代表阿姆哈拉语不同方言的差异. 缺乏公开的实调音频也限制了现实世界条件下的验证,包括真实的移动编码文物和其他通道效果. 隐私和同意要求可能进一步限制获得实时录音的机会。 此外,数据扩增可能无法反映所有现实世界的变异,有可能将泛化限制在看不见的条件下. 今后的工作可以通过以下方式解决这些局限性:包括更多样化的演讲者;在可行的情况下,对照实际通话数据验证模拟条件;扩大基准,以评价口语通信的端到端语音系统和其他组成部分。
